description.value:
You gain the following benefits.

* Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity or Wisdom by 1, to a maximum of 20.

* You have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track or follow beasts and monstrosities

* When you forage, you find twice as much food as you normally would

* You have advantage on attack rolls against beasts and monstrosities that are Medium or smaller.
